blocks.text: MADRID, Spain — Spanish authorities raced to contain any damage to ecologically valuable Mediterranean waters on Thursday after a tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes of diesel capsized off Ibiza, leaving one dead. The Maltese-flagged Med Emre, a chemical products tanker which was travelling from the southern port of Algeciras to Barcelona, suffered the accident in the early hours of Thursday north of the popular holiday island, the Balearic Islands emergency services said. The ship’s 17 crew were rescued but one was later confirmed dead in hospital in Ibiza, while six suffered “minor injuries”, notably hypothermia, the rescuers said. READ: Oil spill […]...
